name: C1: no paint layer on tables
why: The rule is gone: tables paint into the root layer again and every keystroke re-records the visible table.

name: C1: no paint layer on multi-table pages
why: Same removal, seen on a page with two sub-tables.

name: C1: the layer only with sticky headers on
why: The rule moves into applyStickyHeaders()'s stylesheet, so turning sticky headers off silently loses the layer.

name: C1: no paint layer on mobile
why: The removal, seen through the touch emulation.

name: C1: the stuck header no longer covers scrolled rows
why: The thead loses its z-index inside the new stacking context, so a scrolled row's positioned cells could draw over it.
